build_notes: The gnuarmemb toolchain compiled picolibc from source.
Existing architecture headers emitted implicit __rbit declaration warnings with GCC 13.3; all three builds linked successfully.

frdm_mcxa153.note: J-Link MCU-Link probe 1067963845, SWD 1000 kHz, COM10 at 115200 baud. Each corrected image was flashed as HEX by J-Link Commander 9.46 with serial opened before flash. Final boot, layer identity, suite counts, success marker and built PM configuration were checked. No debugger intervention was used during corrected runs.

original_farm_run.note: Reported farm verdicts are not corrected local results. Relevant FREQME driver and MCXA153 devicetree match the local Zephyr tree. Download-error handler logs were not used. Task 908747889 contains an I2S success log, not a FREQME pass.

root_causes.symptom: MCXA precise bus fault during the control test
root_causes.local_reproduction: Original farm baseline ELF stopped in freqme_image_read -> freqme_route_read -> reg_read at PC 0x00000b00, CFSR 0x00008200, BFAR 0x40001180.
root_causes.mechanism: The test directly accesses INPUTMUX after mux_nxp_inputmux_set has called INPUTMUX_Deinit and gated its clock.
root_causes.control: Calling INPUTMUX_Init through GDB before the route read let the unchanged original baseline complete successfully.
root_causes.correction: Bracket raw route reads and clobber writes with INPUTMUX_Init/INPUTMUX_Deinit.

root_causes.symptom: Runtime setup stops printing after the peripheral addresses
root_causes.local_reproduction: Original farm runtime HEX reproduced the truncated output. At exception entry CFSR was 0x00100000 (STKOF), PSP and PSPLIM were both 0x20001800, the lower bound of z_main_stack. The original MAIN_STACK_SIZE was 1024.
root_causes.correction: Set MAIN_STACK_SIZE and ZTEST_STACK_SIZE to 2048 for this case.

limitations: Device-layer TURN_OFF/TURN_ON uses deliberate register clobbering; it is not a real Deep Power Down cycle.
System constraints, system-managed Deep Sleep, real Deep Power Down and other boards were not rerun after the corrections.
No Dapeng job was submitted; no commits, history edits or pushes were performed.
The existing design approval state remains unchanged: Part A revision 6 awaiting review, Part B revision 3 draft.
